title: Individual sign-in
description: Local individual accounts, remembered sessions and password recovery through an administrator.

title: Workspace dashboard
description: Role-aware launchpad for all sections, overall/department reporting, record totals and recent activity.

title: Standard work: checklist and evidence
description: Revision-specific Yes/No checks, camera/file evidence, comments and completed verification history.

title: Saved verification details
description: Expand a saved record to inspect the original revision, answers, comments and evidence references.

title: Time studies: stopwatch and observations
description: Name work elements, record repeated stopwatch observations, review statistics and save raw timings. The visible short observation is a demonstration.

title: Supervisor audits: checks and cycle timing
description: Identify the operator, verify the standard, collect evidence and compare actual cycles against target and tolerance.

title: Training library and video editor
description: Search equipment-linked training, open linked YouTube/Vimeo playback and add resources. Live provider playback is not demonstrated.

title: Troubleshooting library
description: Search readable equipment-specific instructions and add or archive guides.

title: Analytics and detailed statistics
description: Verification totals, No-answer rates, completion times, audit follow-ups, timing variation and detailed records.

title: Downtime: ready to start
description: Choose the machine and reason. Admins also manage reasons, timer availability and shift schedules.

title: Downtime: shared timer running
description: An actual started event is persisted by the server and survives reload. Stop the timer when production resumes.

title: Downtime: stopped event and shift history
description: Stopped records retain their duration, reason, equipment, shift schedule and starter/stopper identities.

title: Leadership: overall performance
description: Complete date-filtered reporting across work, audits, studies, downtime, ideas, problem solving and current resource libraries.

title: Leadership: department performance
description: The same dashboard scoped to Assembly, with department totals, downtime reasons, shift losses and an Excel export.

title: Improvement ideas: submit and follow progress
description: Assign submitter, pilot, validator and participants; describe current/proposed states, location and due date. Existing ideas appear in the pipeline below.

title: Pilot notifications
description: A real in-app assignment generated when the sample idea was created. Open the idea or mark the private message as read.

title: Problem solving: methodology and record dashboard
description: Workbook-based 2D / 4D / 8D selection guidance, department filters, open/closed counts, action totals, overdue follow-ups and the record viewer. Exact Microsoft Forms layouts await accessible references.

title: 2D problem-solving record
description: Find & fix · simple, one-time problems. Method-specific evidence fields, assigned facilitator/reviewer, due date, tracked actions and change history.

title: 4D problem-solving record
description: Department problem · recurring or medium complexity. Method-specific evidence fields, assigned facilitator/reviewer, due date, tracked actions and change history.

title: 8D problem-solving record
description: Major / complex issue · customer or cross-functional impact. Method-specific evidence fields, assigned facilitator/reviewer, due date, tracked actions and change history.

title: Problem solving: action update portal
description: One follow-up queue for open corrective actions and checkpoints. Authorized owners/managers submit status and evidence comments; completed items remain in record history.

title: Equipment and standard management
description: Create equipment hierarchies, author Yes/No steps, require photos, set targets/tolerance and publish immutable standard revisions.

title: Account administration
description: Create or update individual users, assign a role, reset access and deactivate accounts. No sample credentials are included in this gallery.

title: Role permissions
description: Configure server-enforced grants for each role, including the new Problem Solving section.

title: My account and session controls
description: Change your password and revoke other remembered sessions.

title: Tablet dashboard
description: The actual overview at a 768-pixel tablet width, with touch controls and responsive section cards.

title: Mobile dashboard
description: Single-column section cards and horizontally scrolling navigation on a phone-sized viewport.
